work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult XCIII lets Teresa Verzeri erect Sacred Heart confraternities in her institute’s churches with the Roman archconfraternity’s indulgences; transumpt clause and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF18859–18859; the source dating clause at LF18924–18927 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima prima maii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo primo, pontifica- tus Nostri anno decimo primo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
